Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is seeking Student and Staff Computing Devices under bid JA-207652, with contact Jasmine Alzate (JALZATE@dallasisd.org). The products include Chromebooks, a Windows student laptop, tablets, staff laptops and desktops, and touch and non-touch monitors, in quantities of up to 50,000 units per line, with OEM warranties and white glove delivery/deployment services (asset decaling, reporting, etching on laptops, Autopilot for Windows, Google enrollment for Chromebooks). Responses are due 2024-07-09 at 14:00 CST, preferably online via iSupplier or as one original hard copy in a sealed envelope, with no fax or email accepted; a pre-proposal meeting on June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via TEAMS is highly encouraged but not mandatory. The term is three years plus two one-year renewals (max five years), with quote requests expected from September 2024. Required documents include MWBE forms, a W9, Form 1295, signed acknowledgments of Addenda 1 and 2, references and, for resellers, factory-authorized repair and maintenance certifications, while insurance is due within 10 days of award. Bid bond requirements and payment terms were not found in the documents.
